items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: But, uh, not Buddy P.T. That boy is dead. He was buried in the Gerard Cemetery. I forgot his name. But I played with several of them.

ctx.x: When you took up the clarinet, you didn't give up the violin then?

No, For a long while after that, I gave it up. And boys used to come here and get me, you know, to play with them, you know. But, uh, not Buddy P.T. That boy is dead. He was buried in the Gerard Cemetery. I forgot his name. But I played with several of them. The trumpet player, was it? Yeah, he was. A little light-skinned fella. I don't even forgot that boy's name.
